units.source_text: 母亲天生就同美丽的金阁无缘，她却拥有我所不知道的现实感觉。

en.t: My mother was by nature unrelated to the beautiful Golden Pavilion, yet she possessed a sense of reality that I did not know.

units.source_text: 京都不会遭到空袭，尽管这是我的梦想，但也许会是真的。

en.t: Kyoto would not be bombed; although this was my dream, perhaps it might come true.

units.source_text: 假使此后金阁不会遭到空袭的危险，目前我的生存就会失去意义，我所居住的世界就会瓦解。

en.t: If from now on the Golden Pavilion were no longer in danger of being bombed, my present existence would lose its meaning, and the world I lived in would collapse.
